policies.title: Policies
policies.preamble: These InReal Policies (the "Policies" ) explain how InReal works in practice — from signing up, through funding a property, to receiving distributions and exiting. These Policies form part of the InReal legal framework alongside the Master Framework Agreement (the "MFA" ) and each Addendum issued under it, and the InReal Terms & Conditions (the "Terms" ). If anything in these Policies conflicts with your MFA, the MFA takes priority. Your Core Economic Rights are protected in the MFA and cannot be changed by updating these Policies.

clauses.text: These Policies are incorporated by reference into the Terms and into the MFA. They set out the operational detail that both documents refer to.
InReal may update these Policies from time to time (see Section 15). Updates to these Policies do not change the Core Economic Rights under your MFA.
If there is a conflict, the order of precedence is:

items.label: (a)
items.text: first, your Master Framework Agreement and any Addendum issued under it (an Addendum prevails over the main body of the MFA, but only for the property to which it relates);

items.label: (b)
items.text: second, these Policies; and

items.label: (c)
items.text: third, the Terms & Conditions.

clauses.text: These Policies are operational. They do not create economic entitlements. Every economic right you hold arises under the MFA and the applicable Addendum, and is evidenced by your Certificate of Beneficial Ownership.

These Policies are the “Policies” incorporated into the MFA (defined there as the InReal Consolidated Platform Policies), and the Terms are the “Terms” incorporated into the MFA (defined there as the InReal Platform Terms & Conditions). The MFA was previou sly issued under the name Beneficial Ownership Agreement, and a reference in any InReal document to the “Beneficial Ownership Agreement” or “BOA” is a reference to the MFA. A change in the title of any of these documents does not affect its incorporation i nto, or its status under, the MFA.

These Policies use the same defined terms as the MFA. The following additional terms are used in these Policies: "Company" means InReal Holdings Ltd, a BVI Business Company (company number 2205311), which holds each Relevant Property within a dedicated Segregated Portfolio and is the counterparty to your MFA. "Core Economic Rights" means, for the purposes of Section 15 of these Policies and Section 26.2 of the MFA:

items.label: (a)
items.text: your Beneficial Participation Percentage as recorded in the applicable Certificate of Beneficial Ownership;

items.label: (b)
items.text: your entitlement to distributions pro rata to that per centage;

items.label: (c)
items.text: the waterfall priority in Section 13 of the MFA;

items.label: (d)
items.text: the no - encumbrance covenant in Section 9 of the MFA;

items.label: (e)
items.text: the ring - fencing and limited - recourse principles in Section 10 of the MFA;

items.label: (f)
items.text: the Property Liquidator mechanism in Section 19 of the MFA; and

items.label: (g)
items.text: the dispute resolution mechanism in Section 29 of the MFA. "Custody Account" means any segregated bank account, escrow account, or settlement account designated for a specific Relevant Property or Segregated Portfolio. "Ongoing Property Costs" has the meaning given in Section 12.5. "Personal Use Election" means a written election submitted by a Sole Beneficial Owner through the Platform to occupy the Relevant Property for personal use. "Sole Beneficial Owner" means a User holding a Beneficial Participation Percentage of 100% in respect of a Relevant Property. "Tenant Nomination" means a written nomination submitted by a Sole Beneficial Owner through the Platform specifying a proposed tenant and rental price.

clauses.text: Before you can participate in any property opportunity, you need to complete our verification process. This protects you, other Users, and the integrity of the Platform.
What we need from you:

items.label: (a)
items.text: Proof of identity : a valid government - issued photo ID (passport, national ID card, or driving licence).

items.label: (b)
items.text: Proof of address : a recent utility bill, bank statement, or government - issued document showing your current residential address, dated within the last three months.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Tax residency information : your tax identification number and country of tax residence.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Source of funds : information on the origin of the funds you intend to contribute. The level of documentary evidence required depends on your risk tier and the size of your contribution, as set out in our internal compliance framework.

clauses.text: For entity Users (companies, trusts, foundations, and similar), we may also require constitutional documents, a certificate of incorporation or registration, beneficial ownership information for any person holding more than 25% ownership or control, and a board resolution or equivalent authorisation.

InReal may reject, pause, or terminate onboarding at its discretion where required by law, regulation, internal policy, or risk management. Completing verification does not guarantee access to any particular property opportunity.
We may ask you to re - verify your information periodically, or if your circumstances change. Please keep your details up to date through the Platform.

Eligibility is assessed by reference to your jurisdiction of residence and your nationality. Where these differ, the more restrictive treatment applies. United States persons are excluded from participation.
All Users are subject to ongoing identity verification, sanctions screening, and anti - fraud monitoring. We may use third - party providers to assist with these checks.
InReal may freeze, suspend, refuse, reverse, or delay any transaction, distribution, or Transfer where it reasonably considers such action necessary for compliance, risk, or legal purposes.
If we are legally required to file a report with any regulatory authority, we may not be able to tell you about it. This is a legal obligation, not a choice.
We retain compliance records for at least five (5) years after the end of the business relationship, or such longer period as required by law.

Each participation is documented by a numbered Addendum to your MFA, issued under Section 2 of the MFA. The Addendum identifies the property, your contribution, the applicable fees, and the funding deadline. You sign the MFA once; each subsequent participation requires only acceptance of a new Addendum.
All contributions must be made in cleared funds through the payment methods available on the Platform and in the currency specified in the applicable Addendum.

When you become a beneficial owner. Signing the MFA, accepting an Addendum, or sending funds does not by itself make you a beneficial owner. Under Section 6 of the MFA, beneficial participation is conferred only upon the later of

items.label: (a)
items.text: the Company receiving your full contribution in cleared f unds, and

items.label: (b)
items.text: the Company issuing a Certificate of Beneficial Ownership signed or stamped by a director.

clauses.text: Until conferral occurs, any amount received from you is held as a contractual prepayment. It does not earn interest and does not represent an interest in any property. If your participation does not proceed to conferral, the relevant amounts are returned t o you, net of third - party transaction costs reasonably incurred, without interest and within a reasonable period.
We may reject:

items.label: (a)
items.text: payments from third parties — funds must come from an account in your own name;

items.label: (b)
items.text: cash payments;

items.label: (c)
items.text: payments from banks or jurisdictions subject to sanctions or enhanced restrictions; and

items.label: (d)
items.text: payments that raise compliance concerns.

clauses.text: If a payment fails, is recalled, reversed, or blocked, we may suspend or unwind your participation in the relevant property, subject to applicable law and your MFA.

If you miss a funding deadline. Section 5.3 of the MFA allows the Company to cancel, resize, delay, or reject your participation if you do not fund within five (5) Business Days of the stated deadline. In selecting between those outcomes, the Company will act in good faith and will give you a reasonable opportunity to confirm or decline the proposed outcome before it takes effect — except where the property closing timeline does not reasonably permit it, in which case we will tell you what has been done and why.

InReal does not hold User funds in any e - money or stored value account. All contributions are directed to designated bank accounts or Custody Accounts for the benefit of the applicable Segregated Portfolio.

Funding account details. The bank name, account name, account details, and payment reference for each property opportunity are published on the Platform funding page for that opportunity and confirmed in the applicable Addendum. Send funds only to the account details published thr ough the Platform. InReal will not notify you of a change to those details by email alone; if you receive any communication purporting to change them, contact legal@inreal.io to verify before sending funds.
Each Relevant Property is held within its own Segregated Portfolio, with its own ledger and, where reasonably practicable, its own Custody Account.

Under Section 3.5 of the MFA, each Segregated Portfolio holds a single Relevant Property. Assets, proceeds, and liabilities of one Segregated Portfolio are not pooled, aggregated, or co - mingled with those of any other.

Where separate bank accounts are not yet available for a Segregated Portfolio, the Company maintains ledger - level segregation sufficient to identify at all times the amounts, assets, and liabilities attributable to that portfolio. This is the interim stand ard permitted by Section 10.1 of the MFA.

Where the Company is structured as a BVI Segregated Portfolio Company, the statutory ring - fencing provisions of Part XIV of the BVI Business Companies Act 2004 provide legal protection in addition to the contractual protections in the MFA.

No leverage. Under Section 9 of the MFA, the Company does not take out mortgages, financing facilities, or any other form of leverage against a Relevant Property in which Users hold a Beneficial Participation Percentage, without the prior written consent of all such U sers.
InReal may appoint custodians, banks, escrow agents, or payment service providers to support the custody and settlement framework.

All fees applicable to the Platform and to each property opportunity are published on the Platform and described in the Fee Schedule. The fees that apply to your participation are confirmed in your Addendum and shown on your dashboard.

The rate or amount of each fee applicable to a property opportunity is set out in the Fee Schedule for that opportunity, published on the Platform before you commit and confirmed in your Addendum. Fees may include:

items.label: (a)
items.text: Acquisition fee : a percentage of the property acquisition cost, charged once at acquisition.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Management fee : a percentage per annum of property value, charged quarterly and deducted before distributions.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Performance fee : a percentage of net profits above a stated hurdle, charged on sale or liquidation.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Disposition fee : a percentage of gross sale proceeds, charged on sale.

items.label: (e)
items.text: Transfer fee : a fixed amount or percentage per Transfer, charged to the transferor.

items.label: (f)
items.text: Banking and payment fees : actual costs, passed through at cost.

items.label: (g)
items.text: Property - level costs : insurance, maintenance, property management, taxes, and other costs attributable to the property, passed through at cost.

clauses.text: Fees are applied in accordance with the waterfall in Section 13 of the MFA, and are subject to any aggregate fee cap specified in the Fee Schedule.
InReal may update fee structures for future property opportunities. Fee changes do not apply retroactively to your existing participations.
You can view all fees applicable to each of your properties on your Platform dashboard at any time.

sections.heading: How Your Beneficial Participation Percentage Is Calculated

clauses.text: Your Beneficial Participation Percentage is your Net Property Contribution divided by the total Net Property Contributions of all Users in that property. Your Net Property Contribution is your gross contribution less applicable fees and charges.
The percentage is property - specific. If you participate in three properties, you hold three separate and independent Beneficial Participation Percentages.
Your percentage is recorded in the Platform Records and confirmed in your Certificate of Beneficial Ownership for each property.

If you believe there is an error, notify us within fourteen (14) Business Days of the record becoming available on your dashboard. If you do not, the recorded information is treated as accepted, absent manifest error or fraud.

Distributions for each property are made solely from the cash flows and proceeds attributable to that property, after applying the waterfall in Section 13 of the MFA (property - level costs and liabilities first, then fees, then reserves, then distributions to Users).
Reserves are capped at twenty percent (20%) of gross property income in any calendar year, unless the Company approves a higher amount with written justification to Users.
Distributions are made in the currency shown for the property, by transfer to the bank account you have registered with us and which we have accepted.
Distribution frequency is set on a property - by - property basis and communicated through the Platform. Unless otherwise indicated, distributions are processed quarterly.
We may defer a distribution where:

items.label: (a)
items.text: reserves are reasonably required for anticipated property expenses;

items.label: (b)
items.text: compliance checks are pending;

items.label: (c)
items.text: your bank details are incomplete or invalid;

items.label: (d)
items.text: tax determinations remain unresolved; or

items.label: (e)
items.text: legal, regulatory, sanctions, banking, or operational restrictions apply.

clauses.text: Where a distribution is deferred, we will provide a written explanation within ten (10) Business Days, except where disclosure is prohibited by law or by the tipping - off prohibition.
You will receive a distribution statement for each distribution through your dashboard, showing the gross amount, deductions, withholdings, and the net amount distributed.

sections.heading: Exit: Transfers and the Secondary Market

clauses.text: This is a closed - ended, buy - and - hold arrangement. Under Section 3.6 of the MFA you have no right to require the Company to redeem, repurchase, or buy back your interest. Your routes to exit are

items.label: (a)
items.text: a Transfer permitted under Section 15 of the MFA and this Section 10, or

items.label: (b)
items.text: the sale or liquidation of the property itself. Any facility InReal makes available to help Users exit is discretionary and may be limited, suspended, or withdrawn at any time.

clauses.text: Transfers are permitted only where:

items.label: (a)
items.text: the MFA permits the Transfer;

items.label: (b)
items.text: the Transfer is processed through the Platform;

items.label: (c)
items.text: both transferor and transferee satisfy compliance requirements;

items.label: (d)
items.text: the Transfer does not violate any law, sanctions, or contractual restriction; and

items.label: (e)
items.text: InReal approves the Transfer (approval not to be unreasonably withheld).

clauses.text: InReal may facilitate a secondary marketplace on the Platform but does not guarantee liquidity, pricing, counterparty availability, or execution.
InReal may reject a proposed Transfer where the price, counterparty, structure, or terms present compliance, regulatory, reputational, or operational concerns.

clauses.title: Transfer process
clauses.text: When you want to transfer some or all of your beneficial interest in a property:

items.label: (a)
items.text: Submit a Transfer request through the Platform, specifying the property, the portion of your Beneficial Participation Percentage, and either the proposed buyer’s details or your asking price if listing on the secondary market.

items.label: (b)
items.text: The buyer must be a registered User with an executed MFA and completed onboarding. If not yet registered, they must sign up and complete verification first.

items.label: (c)
items.text: InReal screens the buyer. We may reject a Transfer if the buyer does not pass compliance checks.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Once the buyer is verified, InReal confirms the transfer fee, any tax withholding, and settlement details to both parties through the Platform.

items.label: (e)
items.text: On receipt of cleared funds and completion of all checks, we update the Platform Records and issue updated Certificates of Beneficial Ownership. If you transferred your entire interest, your Certificate for that property is cancelled.

items.label: (f)
items.text: The Transfer takes effect when the Platform Records are updated. Until then you remain the holder of record and are entitled to any distributions declared.

items.label: (g)
items.text: We aim to complete the process within fifteen (15) Business Days of receiving everything we need, subject to compliance requirements and any holding period applicable to the property.

items.label: (h)
items.text: Once complete, the transferor has no further right to distributions, proceeds, information, or any other entitlement in respect of the transferred interest, consistent with Section 15.5 of the MFA.

items.label: (a)
items.text: InReal may, at its sole discretion, offer to purchase your Beneficial Participation Percentage directly. This is not always available and may be offered, paused, or withdrawn at any time. It is not a redemption right, a put option, or a guarantee of li quidity, and nothing in this Section 10.6 obliges InReal to make any offer.

items.label: (b)
items.text: To request a buyback, submit a request through the Platform. InReal will respond within ten (10) Business Days with an offer showing the buyback price, the Instant Liquidity Fee, and the expected settlement timeline.

items.label: (c)
items.text: The Instant Liquidity Fee is what InReal charges for providing immediate liquidity. It is five percent (5%) of the buyback price and is deducted before payment to you. The current rate is published on the Platform.

items.label: (d)
items.text: If you accept through the Platform, InReal settles within five (5) Business Days by transferring the net proceeds to your registered bank account.

items.label: (e)
items.text: On settlement, your Beneficial Participation Percentage transfers to InReal or its designated Affiliate, your Certificate of Beneficial Ownership is cancelled, and the Platform Records are updated.

items.label: (f)
items.text: The buyback price may be below what you originally contributed. You are never obliged to accept. You may always use the secondary market instead.

clauses.title: If a User passes away
clauses.text: If a User dies, their beneficial interests do not disappear. Under Section 15.6 of the MFA they pass to the User’s estate or legal successor (the "Successor" ). This section sets out the process.

items.label: (a)
items.text: The Successor should contact InReal at legal@inreal.io or through the Platform, providing: a certified copy of the death certificate; a certified copy of the grant of probate, letters of administration, or equivalent; identification of the Successor an d the basis of entitlement; and, where there are multiple Successors, written instructions signed by all of them (or by the personal representative) specifying how the interests are to be divided.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Each Successor must register on the Platform, execute the MFA, and complete onboarding and verification in the same way as any new User.

items.label: (c)
items.text: InReal will acknowledge receipt of a notification of death within ten (10) Business Days and confirm in writing what documentation is outstanding.

items.label: (d)
items.text: InReal will use commercially reasonable efforts to complete the transmission within sixty (60) days of receiving all required documentation, and will keep the Successor informed in writing of the status and any outstanding requirements.

items.label: (e)
items.text: Once documentation and onboarding are complete, InReal updates the Platform Records and issues new Certificates of Beneficial Ownership. The deceased User’s Certificates are cancelled.

items.label: (f)
items.text: Distributions that accrued but were unpaid at the date of death are released to the Successor once transmission is complete. While transmission is in progress, distributions are held in suspense.

items.label: (g)
items.text: If no Successor comes forward within twelve (12) months of InReal becoming aware of the death, InReal may treat the interest as dormant and hold distributions in suspense until a valid claim is received or a court directs otherwise.

clauses.text: Where a valuation is required — for Transfers, reporting, or dashboard display — InReal may use one or more of: acquisition cost adjusted for known events; third - party appraisal; broker opinion of value; discounted cash flow analysis; market comparable ana lysis; or other reasonable methodologies.

Any valuation shown on the Platform is indicative unless expressly stated otherwise. It is not a guaranteed sale price or liquidation value, and it is not a representation that an interest can be sold at that price.
The methodology used for a given property is disclosed on the Platform alongside the valuation.

If you hold 100% of the beneficial interest in a single property, the enhanced rights set out in this Section 12 are available to you in accordance with Section 12 of the MFA. This section explains how they work in practice. These rights are conferred by t hese Policies and may be varied or withdrawn for future participations in accordance with Section 15.

items.label: (a)
items.text: You may elect to occupy or personally use the Relevant Property by submitting a Personal Use Election through the Platform, specifying the start date and expected duration.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Minimum notice: thirty (30) days before the proposed start date. Elections operate on a quarterly cycle and may be revoked or modified on thirty (30) days’ notice.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Before personal use begins, InReal’s local property manager will conduct a pre - use condition assessment. A post - use assessment is conducted when personal use ends.

items.label: (d)
items.text: During personal use, no rental income is generated. You are responsible for the condition of the property, fair wear and tear excepted.

items.label: (e)
items.text: Ongoing Property Costs continue during personal use and are payable by you under Section 12.5.

items.label: (f)
items.text: Availability is subject to local law. Personal use is only available where occupation by a beneficial owner is permitted under the law of the jurisdiction in which the property is located and does not give rise to adverse ownership, immigration, licensing, or tax consequences for you, the Com pany, or the Segregated Portfolio. InReal may decline a Personal Use Election on those grounds, and will explain the basis in writing.

items.label: (a)
items.text: You may nominate a specific tenant and propose the rental price by submitting a Tenant Nomination through the Platform, specifying the proposed tenant’s name and contact details, the proposed rental price, and the proposed lease term.

items.label: (b)
items.text: InReal will process the nomination within fifteen (15) Business Days.

items.label: (c)
items.text: InReal remains the lessor. The lease is executed by the Company, or by the local holding entity, on InReal’s standard lease template. You are not a party to the lease.

items.label: (d)
items.text: For the avoidance of doubt, a Tenant Nomination is a right conferred by these Policies. It does not confer any voting, board, management, or control right over the Company or any Property Structure, and does not alter Section 4 of the MFA.

clauses.title: Grounds for rejection
clauses.text: InReal may reject a Tenant Nomination on reasonable grounds, including:

items.label: (a)
items.text: the proposed tenant fails KYC, AML, or sanctions screening;

items.label: (b)
items.text: material creditworthiness concerns;

items.label: (c)
items.text: the proposed rental price is materially below fair market value, as determined by InReal acting reasonably; or

items.label: (d)
items.text: acceptance would expose InReal, the Segregated Portfolio, or the local holding entity to legal, regulatory, or tax liability. If a nomination is rejected, InReal will provide a written explanation and you may submit a revised nomination.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Because you are directing the tenancy, you indemnify InReal and the Company against losses arising from a tenancy entered into pursuant to your Tenant Nomination, including tenant default, property damage, early termination, and third - party claims.

items.label: (b)
items.text: InReal may retain up to fifteen percent (15%) of rental proceeds in a holdback reserve until the tenancy concludes without incident. The amount and release conditions are confirmed on your dashboard when the tenancy begins.

items.label: (c)
items.text: If the holdback is insufficient to cover a loss, InReal may deduct the shortfall from future rental proceeds or invoice you directly.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Ongoing Property Costs means management fees, property insurance, local property management fees, maintenance and repair costs, property - level taxes and statutory charges, and other recurring or ad hoc costs attributable to the property as shown on your dashboard.

items.label: (e)
items.text: Where the property generates rental income, Ongoing Property Costs are deducted from rental proceeds before distribution, in accordance with the waterfall in Section 13 of the MFA.

items.label: (f)
items.text: Where the property does not generate rental income, including during personal use, InReal will invoice you for Ongoing Property Costs quarterly. Payment is due within fourteen (14) days of the invoice date. Failure to pay within thirty (30) days of the due date constitutes a material breach of the MFA for the purposes of Section 18.1(b).

clauses.title: Fees unaffected
clauses.text: The rights in this Section 12 do not affect InReal’s entitlement to performance fees, disposition fees, or any other fees payable on the sale or liquidation of the property. These apply in full regardless of whether the property was subject to personal use or a directed tenancy.

clauses.title: Deactivation
clauses.text: The rights in this Section 12 terminate automatically if your Beneficial Participation Percentage falls below 100%. InReal will notify you through the Platform, and any active Personal Use Election or Tenant Nomination will be managed as follows:

items.label: (a)
items.text: Personal use : you will be given sixty (60) days to vacate, after which InReal resumes standard rental management.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Directed tenancy : the existing lease continues to its natural expiry. InReal resumes standard management for any renewal or new tenancy.

clauses.text: InReal is not a tax adviser. You must provide all tax forms, declarations, and residency information we reasonably request, including (as applicable) W - 8, W - 9, CRS/FATCA self - certifications, or equivalents.

InReal may withhold taxes where required by law, or where reasonably necessary pending clarification of your tax status. Amounts withheld are treated as distributed for your benefit to the extent required by law.

We may provide annual summaries or tax - supporting documents through the Platform, but you are solely responsible for your own tax obligations, reporting, and compliance in every jurisdiction applicable to you.

InReal maintains Platform Records for each property, including contribution records, Net Property Contribution calculations, Beneficial Participation Percentages, distributions and withheld amounts, Transfer history, fees and cost allocations, Addenda, and Certificates of Beneficial Ownership.

Through the Platform you have access to summary statements, distribution statements, Certificates of Beneficial Ownership, annual summary reports, and a current view of your holdings and transaction history.
Your information rights relate only to properties in which you hold a Beneficial Participation Percentage. They do not extend to other properties or to InReal’s internal operations.
If we identify a minor clerical or reconciliation error, we may correct it in good faith and will notify you.
Material changes will be notified through the Platform, by email, or by other reasonable means on or before the effective date.

Where a proposed change would materially affect distribution timing, fee calculation methodology, Transfer procedures, valuation methodology, or the rights in Section 12, we will provide a summary of the key changes in the notice.
No change to these Policies reduces, rewrites, or overrides the Core Economic Rights under your MFA, consistent with Section 26.2 of the MFA.
Changes to these Policies apply prospectively. They do not retroactively alter the terms on which an existing participation was confirmed in an Addendum or Certificate of Beneficial Ownership.

InReal and its Affiliates may act in multiple capacities — platform operator, property manager, service provider, fee recipient, and, where Section 10.6 applies, buyer of beneficial interests. These roles may give rise to conflicts of interest.

We manage conflicts by disclosing material conflicts in the applicable Addendum or property documentation; maintaining property - specific ledger segregation; applying the waterfall and fee structures disclosed on the Platform; and exercising discretionary d ecisions, including valuation, reserve, and distribution decisions, in good faith.
InReal processes personal data in accordance with its Privacy Policy and the DIFC Data Protection Law (DIFC Law No. 5 of 2020), consistent with Section 24 of the MFA.

We collect and use your personal data for onboarding and identity verification; compliance; administration of your participations; distribution processing and tax reporting; Transfer facilitation; communications and Platform operations; regulatory and lega l compliance; and fraud prevention.

We may share your personal data with Affiliates; banks and payment processors; identity verification providers; professional advisers; property managers; regulatory and tax authorities; and any person to whom disclosure is required by law.

Personal data may be transferred outside the Dubai International Financial Centre to Affiliates, service providers, and regulatory authorities in jurisdictions where a Relevant Property is located or where InReal operates, subject to contractual protection s providing a comparable standard to the DIFC Data Protection Law.
We retain personal data for at least five (5) years after the end of the business relationship, or such longer period as required by law.
You may request access to or correction of your personal data by contacting privacy@inreal.io.

InReal may rely on administrators, custodians, banks, valuers, legal counsel, compliance providers, accountants, tax advisers, property managers, and other service providers to operate the Platform and administer property opportunities.
InReal may act on information and determinations supplied by such providers unless it has actual knowledge that such reliance would be clearly improper.

Operational notices may be provided through the Platform, dashboard notifications, email, or such other means as InReal may designate. An operational notice is deemed received on the next Business Day after transmission.

Formal notices to InReal shall be sent to legal@inreal.io, with a copy to: InReal Holdings Ltd, c/o FIDESTA Ltd., Charles Court, 1st Floor, 189 Main Street, PO Box 4406, Road Town, Tortola VG1110, British Virgin Islands.

In these Policies, "Business Day" has the meaning given in the MFA: a day, other than a Saturday, Sunday, or gazetted public holiday, on which banks are open for general business in the Dubai International Financial Centre and the United Arab Emirates and the British Virgin Islands.
These Policies and any non - contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with them are governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre.

Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or in connection with these Policies, including any question regarding their existence, validity, or termination, shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration Rules of the Dubai Internatio nal Arbitration Centre (DIAC). The seat of arbitration is the Dubai International Financial Centre. The language of the arbitration is English. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator unless DIAC determines otherwise.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, the parties waive any right to bring claims in a class, collective, consolidated, or representative capacity.
Nothing in this Section 20 prevents either party from seeking urgent interim or conservatory relief from a court of competent jurisdiction.
Nothing in this Section 20 limits any mandatory right you may have under the law of your country of residence.
